title: fix(release): re-read a run-list page whose count is above it before the stable-lane and in-flight reads refuse
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgLMjF66wK7hNcCjXxiT1qmj)_
domain:devx#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaA8pcS7BEcMt15WeW

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：快照通道「稳定发布在途」检查读 release.yml 的进行中、排队运行列表时，若计数比这一页列出的多（页未满），不再当场判 NOT MEASURED，而是按现有 board-read 重试策略再读最多两次（间隔 0.5 秒、1 秒），计数对上就按那次读数判断。
- 为什么改：11-11 01:24Z 的定时快照因一次「计数 2、只列出 1」被拒了一整天。当时 release.yml 只有本运行在跑；实测 GitHub 同类过滤一次计数 12、列表 0，几秒后重读就是 0/0，是计数滞后，不是脚本漏页。
- 风险与回滚：仍是 fail-closed：重读用尽或本运行重试预算用尽仍拒；计数不是数字、或整页 100 条已满时立即拒、不重读。稳定发布的 in-flight 守卫共用这个读取器，滞后自愈后读通，持续不一致仍判「在途」。只改两个脚本，不动 workflow；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` 新增的 `readWholeRunList` 及 `collectPublishRuns`；`scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs` 的 `stableLane` 把同一个重试预算传下去。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test && node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs --self-test`，预期 153 例 / 36 组、194 例 / 23 组全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（卡上 Claim 6807568666 已点名本分支）。

Fixes #32382

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i -c "collectPublishRuns|total_count|count/list|stable-lane|stable lane" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'` has no hit (exit 1)

## What changes

`collectPublishRuns` reads release.yml's `in_progress` and `queued` runs, one page of 100 each, for two readers: the snapshot lane's stable-lane preflight (`snapshot-next.mjs stable-lane`, via `readStableLane`) and the stable lane's in-flight guard (`release-pending-publish.mjs in-flight`, via `publishInFlight`). It refused the whole read on the first page whose `total_count` was above what it listed. One such page refused run 42938356503's snapshot for the day: `listing release.yml's in_progress runs: total_count 2 but 1 listed, so the rest are unread`.

- `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs`: new private `readWholeRunList` reads one status filter. A count above a page that is **not full** is re-read under the existing board-read policy (`BOARD_READ_RETRY` through the run's `boardReadBudget` from `scripts/board-read.mjs`, reused, not copied): at most 3 reads, 500 / 1000 ms apart, each re-read spending one of the run's 4 retries. The first read whose count the page covers is the one judged, and the readings line says what came before it.
- Fail-closed, unchanged in kind: a count still above the page when the ladder or the run's budget is spent throws, as before, now naming each read and the ids each short page listed. A `total_count` that is no number, or a count above a **full** page (the rest sit on a page this read does not take), throws at once with no re-read.
- `collectPublishRuns` and `publishInFlight` take an optional `budget` (default: a fresh `boardReadBudget()`).
- `scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs`: `stableLane` builds its one budget once and hands it to both `retryingReads` and `readStableLane`, so the transient 5xx retries and these re-reads share the run's 4 retries (at most 3 s of sleep for the whole read). That is 5 code lines, plus two comments, outside the self-test of a file the order scoped to "self-test only if its pins need it": the stable-lane pins need the injected sleep to reach the re-read, and the run keeps one bound instead of two.

### The cause, measured (not the calling run)

- At 01:24:14 to 01:24:30Z the only release.yml run in progress was the calling run itself: its neighbours are run 42937320684 (push, completed 01:14:58Z) and run 42939633769 (push, created 01:31:59Z), and `?status=in_progress` / `?status=queued` answer 0 / 0 today, so no older run was stuck. The count of 2 was over the truth of 1. Leaving the calling run out of the comparison would not explain it: with the calling run listed, both sides drop by one and still disagree; with it unlisted, the one run listed would have to be a run that was not in progress.
- The same filter on lint.yml, read four times in a row at about 20:40Z: total_count 12 over an empty page, then 0 / 0 three times. The unfiltered listing that minute had no lint.yml run in progress. The count is the side that lags, and the next read healed it. fleet-write.yml's `in_progress` filter answered the same shape at 21:13Z: total_count 2 over a page listing 1.
- The job log has only the refusal line; the refusal named no ids, so which run was listed at 01:24Z cannot be read back. Each short page now names its ids in the refusal and the note.

### The in-flight guard changes too

`publishInFlight` (release.yml's `in-flight` step before the Releases and image backfills) reads through the same function, so its behaviour moves the same way: a short page that comes out whole on a re-read is judged instead of answering `unreadable`, and a page still short after the ladder answers `in-flight` / `unreadable` for the publish and the image alike, as before. Its CLI reads without `retryingReads`, so it re-reads on a budget of its own with the real 500 / 1000 ms sleeps. Pinned below.

## Tests

`release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, new battery `the in-flight listing -> a count above a short page is re-read ...` (7 cases, through `publishInFlight` and the existing stub API, budget sleep recorded):

- the 01:24Z reading (count 2 over the calling run alone, then whole) is clear, after one re-read 500 ms later spent from the run's budget;
- the `queued` filter short by one, whole on the re-read, is clear;
- a re-read that lists the run the short page left out is read and judged: its publish is in flight;
- a count above the page on every read is `unreadable` for the publish and the image, after 3 reads 500 / 1000 ms apart, and nothing after it is read;
- a run's budget already spent is `unreadable` on the first short page, with no re-read;
- a `total_count` that is absent, null or a string is `unreadable` on the first read;
- a count above a full page of 100 is `unreadable` at once.

`snapshot-next.mjs --self-test`, battery `the stable lane ...` (floor 10 to 13), through `stableLane` and its stub API: the 01:24Z reading passes after two reads; a count above the page on every read throws (NOT MEASURED) after 3 reads, and it is not a `TransientReadFailure`; a `total_count` that is no number throws on the first read.

The stub defaults in `flightWith` and `laneHttp` keep every existing case unchanged (the count is the page's length unless a case sets it; the stub budget never sleeps).

## Acceptance notes

- `collectWaitingRuns` (the `?status=waiting` filter) is untouched: there a count above the list is already a warning, not a refusal, and the version commit's push run is read by `head_sha` beside it.
- The policy's docblock in `scripts/board-read.mjs` lists its callers by file; it is outside this order's file surface and was not edited. The new caller is named in `readWholeRunList`'s docblock.
- No changeset: both files are repo scripts in the private root package, and no package's `files` ships them, so the diff publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).

## Verification

Head `dc97eaae`, merge base `origin/main` `14754c70` (`origin/main` had not moved when merged before opening: already up to date).

<details><summary>Red first, then green</summary>

- Pins committed alone at `6ac0133a` on the unchanged reader: `release-pending-publish` 4 failures across 36 batteries (the two heals, the revealed run, the persistent refusal; the spent budget, no-number and full-page controls green); `snapshot-next` 2 failures (the heal threw `listing release.yml's in_progress runs: total_count 2 but 1 listed, so the rest are unread`, the run's own reason; the persistent case read once, not 3 times).
- With the fix: `release-pending-publish self-test: 153 cases across 36 batteries pass`; `snapshot-next: self-test OK -- 194 case(s) across 23 batteries`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, red, then restored), at head 61438ee7</summary>

- Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `read >= policy.attemptsPerRead` replaced by `read >= 1` plus a marker (anchor 1 to 0, blob `a4e0e422e14b` to `3c6ad2f67030`), so a short page refuses on its first read, the defect put back.
- Red: `release-pending-publish` 4 failures across 36 batteries, the same four; `snapshot-next` 2 failures, the same two.
- Restored by the tool: blob equal to HEAD (`a4e0e422e14b`), `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count 0, `git status --porcelain` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `dc97eaae`: 32 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe: all 32 exit 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 2205 cases) among them. `--ran` reconciliation: 32 derived, 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on both changed files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of 2 paths governed, 221 changed lines. `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate.
- Control-byte scan of both files: no hit.

</details>
